title: Separate candidate source qualification from live control-plane initialization
description: Explicit owner a970326b-87a5-4292-8f22-e1bec0c15f11/92f7fd36 corrects the inventory: no explicit existing check-engine separation item exists. Add ONE proposed bounded item in the existing backlog. Incident observed on canonical cb145e56 and Kernel reservation candidate be1ae951: candidate CLI initialized production schema3 during qualification, installed/canonical schema2 writers relabel it, and native CONTROL_PLANE_SCHEMA_DOWNGRADE_DETECTED currentVersion2 requiredVersion3 then prevents qualification, causing activation/landing circularity. Design supported separation of exact candidate-source execution engine from a versioned, independently fingerprinted compatible receipt/control-plane adapter without migrating live production state merely to test candidate. Preserve actual authenticated native project/area/commit/definition/run/resource/guard/outcome evidence and immutable artifacts. Work owns src/checks, Kernel src/control-plane, Release CLI wiring and QA scenarios/acceptance; agree exact contract, owned paths and scenario consent before any implementation. No old-checker shortcut, fake isolated real-project receipts, gate waiver, install activation, production DB recovery, new identity or parallel queue. TASK-4dc metadata/candidate preparation remains completed; its retained deeper provenance roadmap was not an explicit task until this proposal.
acceptanceCriteria: Work, Kernel, Release and QA review a precise versioned executor/receipt-adapter interface, primary-owned path map and named contribution/scenario consent before implementation or source qualification claims.

Candidate-source checks use an exact clean candidate execution engine without initializing or migrating production control-plane schema; boundary scenarios compare live schema/data/provenance before and after and preserve existing identities, tasks, messages, held reservations and resource guards.

Receipts independently bind actual execution-engine commit/content digest and actual loaded adapter identity/digest/interface/schema version under an explicitly reviewed compatibility contract, plus authenticated native project, area, candidate, definition, run and terminal outcome.

Unknown engine, incompatible adapter, forged compatibility evidence, digest mismatch, stale candidate or changed definition/input/artifact evidence fails closed; an installed older checker is never presumed candidate-equivalent.

Frozen inputs, resource/worktree protections, unknown/error/timeout outcomes and immutable external artifact names/bytes/hashes retain strict exact-commit gate integrity; zero exit or isolated fixture output alone cannot become a real-project PASS receipt.

Strict isolated migration/compatibility/self-host scenarios remain visibly distinct from full operational qualification and cannot be promoted or copied as native real-project receipts; no production-state recovery or activation follows from fixture success.

Preserve all prior schema guard refusals, old unqualified receipts, archives, assertions and Test Integrity Notes; eventual independent QA acceptance and fresh exact native checks plus serialized guarded integration are required without gate waivers.
feature: Check execution provenance and state isolation
